purpose: Teach: 相模原/小嶋/佐原/文京/原画/沢田/クイック/壇上

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが神奈川県相模原に出張された
lines.en: Gran, when Dad was young, he took a business trip to Sagamihara in Kanagawa Prefecture.
lines.style: Soft, nostalgic opening. Gentle reach into memory. Even pace, unhurried. Voice carries the weight of years but no sadness—just the quietness of recall.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん、お祖父ちゃん、若い頃、ご友人の小嶋さんと文通されたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Yes, and you know, when your grandfather was young, he used to exchange letters with his friend Kojima, didn't he?
lines.style: Warm, playful parry. A knowing smile in the voice. Gently teasing—she's turned the conversation back to his memory, his youth. Affectionate without being sentimental.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが千葉県佐原の祭りを観られた
lines.en: Gran, when Dad was young, he went to the Sawara Festival in Chiba Prefecture.
lines.style: The same gentle reverie. Settling deeper into the memory. Slower, more deliberate than before. Voice trails slightly—he's seeing it again.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、若い頃、東京の文京区の大学に通われたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: And you went to university in the Bunkyo ward of Tokyo when you were young, didn't you?
lines.style: Light, persistent warmth. A knowing laugh underneath. She's matching his rhythm but won't let him have all the nostalgia—she's reminding him she was there too. Tender underneath the gentle correction.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが映画の原画展に通われた
lines.en: Gran, when Dad was young, he loved going to original animation exhibitions.
lines.style: Voice grows quieter, more absorbed. He's moving deeper into the details now. Each phrase lands softly. Breathing is slower, like he's opening a box he hasn't touched in years.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、若い頃、沢田研二のコンサートに行かれたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: You went to a Kenji Sawada concert when you were young, remember?
lines.style: Brighter this time, almost conspiratorial. A gentle jab of remembrance—she's caught him in a moment he'd almost kept to himself. Voice lifts slightly at the end. Playful, but the affection is unmissable.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんがクイック現像、つまりクイック写真を愛用された
lines.en: Gran, when Dad was young, he was devoted to quick photo processing—what they called quick photos back then.
lines.style: Voice becomes almost tender now. Quieter, more intimate. He's sharing something small and specific. The words come slowly, as if offering up a detail he's held onto for decades.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、若い頃、講演会で壇上に立たれたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: And you stood on stage at a lecture hall when you were young, didn't you?
lines.style: Close, warm, final. Voice is soft but sure. She's turning it back to him one last time—gently, without strain. A small smile. The affection has won. Trailing warmth at the end, like she's tucking something back into memory with him.
